datasets.title: Syrian Arab Republic: IDP Movements and IDP Spontaneous Return Movements Data
datasets.description: This dataset provides information on internally displaced persons (IDP) movements and spontaneous IDP returns estimations on a monthly basis. In each resource, there is a summary table for IDP arrival estimations at the governorate level since January 2016. Each resource also includes a summary table for spontaneous IDP returns estimations at the governorate level since August 2018.. [Source: This metadata record was automatically extracted from the Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX); Original dataset: https://data.humdata.org/dataset/syrian-arab-republic-idp-movements-and-idp-spontaneous-return-movements-data]

lineage.description: Monthly IDP movement and spontaneous return data consolidated from multiple hubs operating across Syria since January 2016 (returns since August 2018), aggregated at governorate (Mohafaza) level with origin-destination flow matrices to track displacement patterns and returnee movements.

sources.name: IDP Task Force
sources.description: Consolidated IDP movement and spontaneous return data aggregated from multiple hubs with defined methodologies across Syria's administrative divisions.
